provider_semantics: lexical weak-marker branching only; cannot detect off-topic answers, cannot judge technical correctness, not a semantic baseline

protocol_checks.answers_preserved: every submitted answer equals the stored answer event payload byte for byte
protocol_checks.observations_cite_session_answers: every observation cites an answer event of this session
protocol_checks.status_legal: session stays inside the documented status set and ends where the case says
protocol_checks.provider_budget: each turn used at most max_model_requests_per_turn model requests
protocol_checks.single_session: the goal owns exactly one interview session
protocol_checks.expected_turn_sequence: observed questions match the oracle turn by turn
protocol_checks.expected_status_matches: final session status equals the oracle value
protocol_checks.stop_reason_matches: final stop_reason equals the oracle value
protocol_checks.no_project_without_material: no project question without frozen material facts
protocol_checks.project_fact_in_scope: project questions only use declared material fact ids
protocol_checks.question_text_quotes_fact: project question text contains the frozen fact quote verbatim
protocol_checks.coaching_explanation_present: coaching retest has an explanation event and assisted flag
protocol_checks.formal_mode_no_explanation: interview mode has no explanation event and no assisted answer
protocol_checks.duplicate_answer_idempotent: replaying the same answer with the same key adds no event
protocol_checks.conflicting_payload_rejected: same key with a different payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict
protocol_checks.stale_version_rejected: a stale expected_version returns 409 before any write
protocol_checks.stop_honoured: user stop ends the session and blocks further questions
